76156.name: Stalk With The Earthmother
objectivesText: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.

76240.name: Stalk With The Earthmother
objectivesText: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.

91209.name: Continue Your Training
objectivesText: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.

91282.name: A Second Home
objectivesText: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.

91285.name: Murlocs at the Gates
objectivesText: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.

91294.name: Touring the Grounds

91316.name: Making Repairs
objectivesText: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.

91317.name: The Tarnished
objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.

91858.name: Diplomatic Incident
objectivesText: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.

91859.name: A Curious Pair
objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.

91860.name: A Grim Fate
objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.

91861.name: Into Fenris Keep
objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.

91862.name: Lumina Windsinger
objectivesText: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.

91920.name: Wild Eyes

91921.name: Return to Quinn (Again)
objectivesText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

92706.name: WANTED: Bruuz

93739.name: Exploring the Horde
objectivesText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

94427.name: A Lesson in Divinity

94434.name: A Lesson in Divinity

94435.name: A Lesson in Divinity
objectivesText: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.

94436.name: A Lesson in Divinity
objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.

94438.name: A Lesson in Divinity

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.

94440.name: A Lesson in Divinity
objectivesText: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

94441.name: A Lesson in Divinity
objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.

94911.name: Child of Nature

94913.name: Moonglade
objectivesText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

95314.name: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95328.name: Whispering Horror Residue

95350.name: Welcome to Azeroth

95494.name: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495.name: The Hermit Tanner

95507.name: Vrang's Game

95508.name: Unwelcome Guests

95621.name: Trouble in the Valley
objectivesText: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.

95774.name: Her Name Is Olgra
objectivesText: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.

95803.name: A Token of Good Faith
objectivesText: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.

95805.name: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
objectivesText: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

95883.name: The Tortured Soul

95884.name: The Offering Stone

95885.name: The Offering of Blood
objectivesText: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.

95981.name: Watching the Roads

96130.name: Chakuyak

96204.name: The Windshaper's Wrath

96821.name: Legging It

96822.name: For Honor

96825.name: This Fruit Could Bite Back
objectivesText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.

96873.name: A Pain in the Neck
objectivesText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.

96874.name: This Is Spinal Axe
objectivesText: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.

96875.name: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.

96876.name: Ukor's Lost Pack

96877.name: Halikor's Hoof

96896.name: A Righteous Cause
objectivesText: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.

96897.name: The Cult of the Damned

96899.name: Bandarion Keep

97003.name: Chol'aruk the Ravener

objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.

97249.name: Favorite Food
objectivesText: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.

97275.name: Whuut's the Rush

97290.name: Unending Torment

97326.name: Rocks to Rests

97485.name: Traditions of the Bluff
objectivesText: Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.
Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.

97558.name: Hides for the Forsaken
objectivesText: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.

97583.name: WRIGGLE.
objectivesText: Purchase Nutritious Slime Sludge and return to your befriended excitable slime. If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention.

97891.name: Prompt Potion Runner
objectivesText: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.

98024.name: Journey to the Crossroads
objectivesText: Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.

98093.name: Field to Clear

98251.name: Never Coming Back

98298.name: Arugal's Folly

98299.name: Stop the Spread

98340.name: The Great Cat Spirit

98389.name: A Light in the Darkness

98424.name: Fizsprocket's Notes

98427.name: Ceasing Operations

98430.name: The Longwalkers

98435.name: Thunderhorn's Report

98545.name: Leonid's Letter

98575.name: Tainted Tablet

98576.name: Glyphic Parchment

98601.name: A Difficult Path

99048.name: A Missing Hand

99049.name: Threat from Below
objectivesText: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.

99051.name: Threat from Below
objectivesText: Collect 9 Naga Spinefins.

99052.name: Threat from Below
objectivesText: Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.

99079.name: Longwalker Malah

99081.name: Grim Tidings
objectivesText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.

99082.name: The High Chieftain
objectivesText: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

99101.name: Our Ancient Enemy
objectivesText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

99108.name: Sparring Match

99123.name: Lost in the Shadows

99134.name: Discipline

99141.name: Patience

99142.name: Tomb Weed

99144.name: Seeking Refuge
objectivesText: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.

99152.name: As Above, So Below
objectivesText: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.

99153.name: The One That Got Away

99156.name: Rear Guard Patrol
objectivesText: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.

99411.name: Kyle's Gone Missing!
objectivesText: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.
Feed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
